text:
ASM::username
Description
Returns the username from a login attempt throughout the login session.
If there is no login session or the login page in the policy does not
extract credentials, then an empty string is returned.
Syntax
ASM
::
username
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
if
{[
ASM
::
is_authenticated
]}
{
log
local0.
"This request was sent by user [ASM::username]."
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_DONE,ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION, ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING, ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION, ASM_RESPONSE_LOGIN
Introduced: BIGIP-17.1.0
